task: [Автозадача из бэклога] [[DISCUSS]] Проект ЛАПА (C:\Users\rafie\bridge-projects\lapa): добавить слой-ПЛАНИРОВЩИК поверх существующих надёжных рук (5-гейтовый loop + навыки open/type/telegram + vision-для-canvas). ЦЕЛЬ оператора: лапа автономно выполняет ВЫСОКОУРОВНЕВЫЕ задачи, САМА декомпозируя их в последовательность loop-действий (open→perceive→navigate→act), используя vision когда застряла, с теми же fail-closed гарантиями + declared-risk ladder (системные настройки/отправки требуют confirm) + STOP. РЕЖИМ Discuss-First: обсуди дизайн (LLM-декомпозиция задачи в шаги? task-graph? верификация и восстановление каждого шага? как встроить vision в ПЛАНИРОВАНИЕ, а не только в locate элемента?), сделай PROJECT_BRIEF→DISCUSS_*→PROJECT_MAP→PROJECT_PLAN→contract, дай оператору на ревью ДО реализации. НЕ генерить атомы до утверждения плана.
goal: Lapa autonomously executes high-level tasks by self-decomposing them into a sequence of loop actions (open→perceive→navigate→act), bridging the gap towards Lapa doing everything the operator does, autonomously.
constraints: Do not generate atoms until the plan is approved.
The process must follow a 'Discuss-First' mode.
The new planner layer must maintain existing fail-closed guarantees.
The new planner layer must incorporate a declared-risk ladder (system settings/sends require confirmation).
The new planner layer must include a STOP mechanism.
The output must be reviewed by the operator BEFORE implementation.
known_context: Existing capabilities ('reliable hands') include: a 5-gate loop, open/type/telegram skills, and vision-for-canvas.
Currently, Lapa executes *given* specific actions but does NOT plan tasks itself; planning is done by the operator.
output_format: A sequence of documents: PROJECT_BRIEF → DISCUSS_* → PROJECT_MAP → PROJECT_PLAN → contract (JSON object matching this schema).
success_tests: DISCUSS_* documents (covering design questions like LLM decomposition, task-graph, step verification/recovery, vision integration into planning) are created.
A TaskContract (this JSON object) is created.
The operator reviews and approves the PROJECT_PLAN and the TaskContract before any implementation begins.
The proposed design in the PROJECT_PLAN addresses the integration of vision into the *planning* process, not just element location.
